answer_1.quote: Following the setup of many existing interpretability studies, we look into the next token prediction behavior of autoregressive LLMs in their inference mode, namely which predicts the k-th token t_k given all the previous tokens in the context.

answer_2.quote: We measure the values of the logits of t_fact and t_cofa as they evolve in the residual stream... and the strength of the factual recall mechanism.
